query:
UPDATE infrastructure_servers
                     SET label = $2,
                         server_ip = $3,
                         coolify_base_url = $4,
                         coolify_project_uuid = $5,
                         secret_ref = $6,
                         ssh_secret_ref = $7,
                         is_active = TRUE,
                         updated_at = NOW()
                   WHERE coolify_server_uuid = $1
                  RETURNING id, label, server_ip, coolify_server_uuid
